Read the single-file browser game at /config/workspace/games/zelena-imperija/zelena-imperija.html.
It is a FarmVille-style cannabis-growing tycoon game. Design spec: /config/workspace/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-zelena-imperija-design.md.
All player-facing text is Macedonian Cyrillic; all code identifiers are Latin-transliterated
Macedonian (zasadiSemka, parichnik, presmetajKvalitet). This is deliberate — do NOT report
the Macedonian naming or the Macedonian UI as a problem, and do not suggest renaming to English.
It must stay ONE self-contained file with no external assets, no build step, no network calls —
do NOT suggest splitting it into modules, adding a bundler, or adding dependencies.
Report ONLY concrete defects you can point at in the actual code. No speculation, no style
preferences, no "consider adding tests". If you find nothing real in your lens, return an empty list.

YOUR LENS: game economy and exploits. Hunt for ways a player breaks or trivialises the game.
Specifically check: can money ever go negative, NaN, or Infinity? Can any action be repeated
for free profit (watering, feeding, treating, harvesting, selling the same batch twice)?
Can the same sushara/magacin batch be processed twice via a double click before the array
splice lands? Are level gates enforced on BOTH the button-disabled path and the function
itself? Can otkluchiLeja exceed MAX_LEI? Can kupiLampa downgrade or be bought twice?
Does XP ever grant an infinite level-up loop? Is there any dominant degenerate strategy
(e.g. never feeding, or harvesting instantly, or holding inventory forever) that beats
playing properly? Does the market drift clamp actually bound the price?
Trace the actual code paths — do not guess.

1	# „Зелена Империја" — Design Spec
2	
3	**Date:** 2026-08-02
4	**Status:** Approved (Approach A)
5	**Deliverable:** `games/zelena-imperija/zelena-imperija.html` — one self-contained file
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 1. Summary
10	
11	A browser farming/tycoon game in the FarmVille lineage, themed on a **licensed** cannabis
12	grow operation. The player buys seeds, plants them in beds, keeps them watered / fed / free
13	of pests, harvests, dries and cures the crop, optionally pays for lab analysis, and sells on
14	a fluctuating market. Profit buys more beds, better lamps, automation and premium genetics.
15	
16	All player-facing text is **Macedonian Cyrillic**. All code identifiers are
17	**Latin-transliterated Macedonian** (`zasadiSemka()`, `parichnik`, `presmetajKvalitet()`).
18	
19	Framing is deliberately a legal, licensed, lab-tested operation — not a crime game. There is
20	no law-enforcement mechanic and no real-world cultivation instruction; every number below is
21	a game-balance value chosen for pacing, not horticultural advice.
22	
23	## 2. Goals / Non-goals
24	
25	**Goals**
26	- Complete seed → sale loop playable in ~3 minutes, deep enough to replay for an hour.
27	- Care decisions (water, nutrients, pest treatment, cure timing) visibly change payout.
28	- Zero install, zero assets, zero build step. Double-click the file and play.
29	- Balancing is data, not logic: strains/upgrades/events/prices live in tables.
30	
31	**Non-goals**
32	- Multiplayer, accounts, leaderboards, server-authoritative time.
33	- Offline progression while the tab is closed.
34	- Pixel art or sprite sheets (would break the single-file constraint).
35	
36	## 3. Architecture
37	
38	Single `index.html`-style document, three blocks:
39	
40	```
41	<style>   design tokens, layout grid, CSS/SVG plant art, animations
42	<body>    static shell — header HUD, bed grid, side panels, toast rail, modal
43	<script>
44	  KONFIG      constants: tick rate, stage lengths, starting state
45	  SORTI       strain table
46	  NADGRADBI   upgrade table
47	  NASTANI     pest/event table
48	  TEKST       every Macedonian UI string, one place
49	  sostojba    the single mutable game-state object
50	  ── engine   tikni() presmetajRast() primeniNastan() presmetajPrinos() presmetajKvalitet()
51	  ── akcii    zasadi() polej() nahrani() tretiraj() oberi() zavrsiSushenje()
52	              testirajVoLaboratorija() prodaj() kupiNadgradba()
53	  ── prikaz   iscrtajSe() iscrtajLeja() iscrtajPaneli()   (dirty-flag patching)
54	  ── zapis    zachuvaj() vchitaj()
55	```
56	
57	**Rendering.** Bed DOM nodes are created once and mutated in place — the tick handler patches
58	text, `class` and CSS custom properties only. Shop / inventory / market lists re-render only
59	when their backing data changes, guarded by a dirty flag. No innerHTML churn in the hot path.
60	
61	**Plant art.** Pure CSS + inline SVG. Stem height, leaf scale and bud opacity are driven by
62	CSS custom properties written from state; hue rotates toward yellow-brown as health falls.
63	This keeps the file asset-free and makes growth animation free.
64	
65	**Isolation.** Engine functions are pure where practical: `presmetajKvalitet()` and
66	`presmetajPrinos()` take values and return numbers, touching no globals. That makes them
67	testable from the console and safe for the player to re-tune.
68	
69	## 4. Time model
70	
71	| Constant | Value | Meaning |
72	|---|---|---|
73	| `TIK_MS` | 250 | real ms per tick |
74	| `CHASA_PO_TIK` | 3 | game hours advanced per tick |
75	| — | 8 ticks | one game day = **2 real seconds** |
76	| `AVTOSEJV_TIKOVI` | 40 | autosave every 10 real seconds |
77	
78	Uses `setInterval` with a delta-time guard: if the tab was backgrounded and timers were
79	throttled, catch-up is capped at 8 ticks per invocation so returning to the tab never
80	fast-forwards a whole crop.
81	
82	## 5. Plant lifecycle
83	
84	| Faza | Macedonian | Game days | Real seconds |
85	|---|---|---|---|
86	| `NIKNENJE` | Никнење | 3 | 6 |
87	| `VEGETACIJA` | Вегетација | 21 | 42 |
88	| `CVETANJE` | Цветање | 50 | 100 |
89	| `ZRELO` | Зрело | 14-day window | 28 |
90	
91	Total seed→ready ≈ 74 game days ≈ 148 s. Strain `brzina` multiplier scales all three stages.
92	Past the 14-day ripe window the plant over-ripens: quality decays 1.5 points per game day.
93	
94	Harvest moves the crop into the **Сушара** as a batch, not back into a bed. Batch dries over
95	game days; the player chooses when to pull it.
96	
97	`zavrsiSushenje()` converts elapsed drying days into **`tochnostSushenje`, a 0–1 accuracy
98	value** — the single cure figure consumed by `presmetajKvalitet()`:
99	
100	| Cure timing | Days elapsed | `tochnostSushenje` |
101	|---|---|---|
102	| Premature | ≤ 8 | 0.55 |
103	| Optimal | 9 – 12 | 1.00 |
104	| Acceptable | 13 – 16 | 0.80 |
105	| Over-cured | ≥ 17 | 0.65 |
106	
107	Boundaries are inclusive as written and cover every integer day with no gap. The Сушара
108	upgrade speeds drying 40% and widens the optimal band to 8–14 days.
109	
110	## 6. Plant state and care
111	
112	Each bed holds `{sorta, faza, vozrast, voda, hraniva, zdravje, shtetnik, zbirZdravje, brojTikovi}`.
113	
114	**Drain per game day:** `voda` −6, `hraniva` −3. Both clamp to 0–100.
115	
116	**Health deltas per tick** (`zdravje` clamps 0–100):
117	
118	| Condition | Δ zdravje |
119	|---|---|
120	| `voda` < 20 (drought) | −1.2 |
121	| `voda` > 95 (root rot) | −0.8 |
122	| `hraniva` < 15 (starved) | −0.9 |
123	| `hraniva` > 95 (nutrient burn) | −0.6 |
124	| active untreated `shtetnik` | −event.šteta |
125	| everything in optimal range | +0.4 |
126	
127	Both under- and over-watering hurt, so "click water on everything constantly" is a losing
128	strategy — that asymmetry is what makes the care loop a skill rather than a chore.
129	
130	`zbirZdravje` accumulates each tick; lifetime average health at harvest is
131	`zbirZdravje / brojTikovi` and is the dominant input to both yield and quality.
132	
133	**Actions:** Полевање +45 `voda`, free. Ѓубриво +40 `hraniva`, 250 ден.
134	
135	## 7. Pests and events
136	
137	Per plant, per game day: 3% base chance, × 0.4 with the Клима-систем upgrade.
138	
139	| id | Macedonian | Штета/tick | Третман | Цена | Note |
140	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
141	| `grini` | Пајакови грини | 0.9 | Акарицид | 900 | any stage |
142	| `muvla` | Мувла | 1.4 | Фунгицид | 1400 | only during Цветање |
143	| `voshki` | Лисни вошки | 0.6 | Инсектицид | 700 | any stage |
144	| `azot` | Недостаток на азот | 0.5 | — | — | cleared by `nahrani()`, not by `tretiraj()` |
145	
146	`azot` is the one event with no purchasable treatment: feeding the plant clears it, which
147	teaches the nutrient mechanic instead of taxing it. Untreated pest-days also count against
148	final quality via the `pestDays` input.
149	
150	## 8. Yield and quality
151	
152	```
153	prinos_grama = sorta.prinos × (prosekZdravje / 100) ** 1.2 × lampa.prinosMult
154	```
155	
156	`presmetajKvalitet()` returns 0–100 from: `prosekZdravje` (0–100), `tochnostSushenje` (0–1,
157	per §5), `sorta.genetika` (0–1), `lampa.kvalitetBonus` (0–14), `pestDays` (integer).
158	
159	**This function is the player-tunable balance knob** and ships with a documented default
160	implementation plus a TODO block explaining the trade-off (reward patience vs. reward volume),
161	so the game is fully playable as delivered and the formula is a drop-in replacement.
162	
163	| Grade | Score | Macedonian | Price × |
164	|---|---|---|---|
165	| A+ | ≥ 85 | Врвен | 2.2 |
166	| A | ≥ 70 | Одличен | 1.6 |
167	| B | ≥ 50 | Среден | 1.1 |
168	| C | < 50 | Слаб | 0.6 |
169	
170	**Лабораториска анализа:** 900 ден per batch. Reveals THC% (derived from quality + genetics)
171	and applies a +18% certified-product premium on sale.
172	
173	## 9. Content tables
174	
175	**Сорти** — `cena` = seed price, `prinos` = base grams, `traenje` = **duration** multiplier.
176	Note the direction: `0.85` means the strain finishes 15% *sooner*, `1.35` means it takes 35%
177	*longer*. Premium genetics are slower, not faster — the field is named `traenje` (duration)
178	rather than `brzina` (speed) precisely so the sign cannot be misread.
179	
180	| id | Име | Цена | Траење | Принос | Генетика | Ден/г | Ниво |
181	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
182	| `skopsko` | Скопско Зелено | 150 | 0.85 | 60 | 0.45 | 90 | 1 |
183	| `vardar` | Вардар Куш | 400 | 1.00 | 85 | 0.60 | 140 | 2 |
184	| `pelister` | Пелистерска Магла | 900 | 1.10 | 110 | 0.72 | 200 | 4 |
185	| `ohrid` | Охридски Кристал | 1800 | 1.15 | 130 | 0.82 | 280 | 6 |
186	| `shar` | Шар Планина Хаза | 3200 | 1.25 | 155 | 0.90 | 380 | 8 |
187	| `dojran` | Дојранска Ноќ | 6000 | 1.35 | 185 | 0.97 | 520 | 11 |
188	
189	**Надградби**
190	
191	| Надградба | Цена | Ефект |
192	|---|---|---|
193	| Нова леја | 75 000 × 1.6ⁿ | +1 bed, 4 → 12. `n` = beds already purchased beyond the starting 4, so the first costs 75 000 and the eighth 75 000 × 1.6⁷ |
194	| Ламба: ХПС | 220 000 | принос ×1.15, квалитет +4 |
195	| Ламба: ЛЕД | 700 000 | принос ×1.30, квалитет +8 |
196	| Ламба: ЛЕД Full-Spectrum | 2 400 000 | принос ×1.50, квалитет +14 |
197	| Автоматско наводнување | 240 000 | holds `voda` ≥ 55 |
198	| Клима-систем | 360 000 | pest chance ×0.4 |
199	| Сушара | 300 000 | drying 40% faster, optimal band widened to 8–14 days |
200	| Работник | 900 000 | auto-feeds when `hraniva` < 40 |
201	
202	Lamps are a single upgrade track: buying a tier replaces the previous one, and only the
203	highest owned tier applies.
204	
205	**Пазар.** Per-strain price multiplier random-walks ±3% per game day, clamped to [0.75, 1.35].
206	Inventory can be held for a better price, which is the whole reason the market panel exists.
207	
208	**Напредок.** XP on sale = grams × grade multiplier. Level *n* needs `500 × n^1.5` XP.
209	Levels gate strains and lamp tiers.
210	
211	**Старт.** 8000 ден, 4 beds, 1 free Скопско Зелено seed, Флуо lamp.
212	
213	**Measured pacing** (headless run, full care, starter strain): net 7 801 ден per plant per
214	126 s cycle; 3 cycles to the first extra bed, 8 to the HPS lamp. Endgame (Дојранска Ноќ +
215	ЛЕД Full-Spectrum) nets 282 629 ден per plant — a 36× curve against ~10.4 M ден of total
216	upgrades. With no care at all the same plant *loses* 95 ден, so neglect is a real failure state.
217	
218	## 10. Persistence and error handling
219	
220	Autosave to `localStorage` under `zelena-imperija-sejv` with a `verzija` field.
221	
222	| Failure | Behaviour |
223	|---|---|
224	| `localStorage` unavailable or over quota | catch, Macedonian toast, continue in memory |
225	| Corrupt JSON | `try/catch`, start fresh, Macedonian notice |
226	| `verzija` mismatch | start fresh, Macedonian notice |
227	| Missing/renamed strain or upgrade id in save | drop that entry, keep the rest |
228	
229	No offline fast-forward: with an accelerated clock it would only reward changing the system

content.text: Verified every claim by running the game's `window.__test` hook headlessly under Node with a DOM stub. Guards I checked and found **sound** (not reported): `naplati()` floors money at 0 on every spend path; `otkluchiLeja` cannot exceed `MAX_LEI`; `kupiLampa` cannot downgrade or double-charge; level gates are enforced inside `kupiSeme`/`kupiLampa`, not only via `disabled`; double-clicking `oberi`/`zavrsiSushenje`/`prodaj`/`testirajVoLaboratorija` cannot double-process (the `findIndex`+`splice` is synchronous); `dodadiIskustvo` cannot loop forever; the market clamp holds exactly at [0.75, 1.35] over 100 000 simulated game days; strain revenue-per-second is monotonic across all six tiers.

findings.title: Over-ripening penalty is fully cancelled by passive health recovery — the 14-day ripe window costs nothing, and neglect can be repaired by parking a plant in ZRELO
findings.location: tikni(), the `if (dobro) delta += KONFIG.OPORAVUVANJE;` / `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje;` lines and the `else { r.faza = "ZRELO"; ... KONFIG.KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN * delDena ... }` block
findings.problem: KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN is 1.5 per game DAY, while OPORAVUVANJE is 0.4 per TICK = 3.2 per game day for any plant whose voda/hraniva are merely in range and has no pest. Net drift while over-ripe is +1.7/day, so health pins at the clamp. Worse, `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` runs BEFORE the over-ripe subtraction in the same tick, so the number folded into the lifetime average is the post-recovery clamped 100 every single tick — the penalty never touches `prosekZdravje` at all. Since `prosekZdravje = zbirZdravje / brojTikovi` is an unweighted lifetime mean and is the dominant input to BOTH presmetajPrinos and presmetajKvalitet, leaving a plant ripe indefinitely is free, and it actively launders away earlier neglect. Spec §5 says "Past the 14-day ripe window the plant over-ripens: quality decays 1.5 points per game day" — measured decay is zero.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured, deterministic: plant Скопско Зелено with Автоматско наводнување + Вработен работник bought, never touch it again. It reaches ZRELO with lifetime avg 100.00, then after 5000 further ticks (625 game days past the 14-day window) zdravje reads 99.81 and lifetime avg is still 100.00 — the 'презрело' toast fires once and nothing else happens. Second run, the rescue exploit: never water or feed the plant at all during growth; it reaches ZRELO with zdravje 0 and lifetime avg 21.26 (would grade Слаб, ~9 g). Now start watering it while it sits in ZRELO: after 1904 total ticks avg = 70.85, after 5904 avg = 90.60, after 55904 avg = 99.01. Harvesting at that point yields 59.3 g at quality 72.8 = 'Одличен' (×1.6) — indistinguishable from a perfectly tended plant. Result: harvest timing is a decision with no downside, and a ruined crop is fully recoverable by waiting.
findings.fix: Two changes in tikni(): (1) move the over-ripe subtraction above `r.zbirZdravje += r.zdravje` so the penalty actually enters the lifetime average; (2) make the penalty beat recovery — skip the `OPORAVUVANJE` bonus when `preku > 0`, and/or raise KAZNA_PREZRELOST_DEN above 3.2/day. Cleaner still: stop routing over-ripeness through clamped `zdravje` and accumulate a separate `deoviPrezrelo` counter on the plant (mirroring `deoviSoStetnik`), carry it into the sushara batch in oberi(), and subtract it directly in presmetajKvalitet — that also stops the lifetime-average laundering, since a fixed penalty cannot be diluted by adding ticks.

findings.title: Lamp bonuses are read at harvest and at dry-completion time, so the lamp can be bought retroactively and upgrades everything already in the pipeline
findings.problem: Neither `prinosMult` nor `kvalitetBonus` is captured on the plant at planting time or on the batch at harvest time. Both are looked up live from `sostojba.lampa` at the moment the action resolves, so a lamp bought after a plant has finished growing (or even after it has been harvested and is sitting in the сушара) applies its full effect to that crop.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured: two Скопско Зелено plants grown to ZRELO entirely under the free Флуо lamp with identical care. Harvest bed 0 → 272.7 g wet. Buy ЛЕД Full-Spectrum, then harvest bed 1 → 409.1 g wet (exactly ×1.50) from a plant that never saw the lamp. Then finish drying BOTH: batch A, which was harvested before the purchase, comes out at quality 87.5 'Врвен' instead of the 73.5 'Одличен' it should have — it collected the +14 kvalitetBonus purely because zavrsiSushenje ran after the lamp was bought. Optimal play is therefore to buy no lamp at all while growing, fill all 12 beds plus the dryer queue, then buy the top tier once and retroactively upgrade every in-flight batch — with 12 Дојранска Ноќ beds that is on the order of 2 M ден of free value, roughly the price of the lamp itself.
findings.fix: Snapshot the lamp on the crop instead of reading it live: store `prinosMult: tekovnaLampa().prinosMult` on the plant object created in zasadiSemka(), and store `lampaBonus: tekovnaLampa().kvalitetBonus` on the batch pushed in oberi(); have oberi() and zavrsiSushenje() use the stored values. Add the same fallbacks in normalizirajRastenie() and the vchitaj() sushara filter for old saves.

findings.title: Professional Сушара upgrade retroactively re-grades batches already drying, and can jump a batch from 'premature' straight to 'ideal'
findings.problem: Same root cause as the lamp: whether the player owns the сушара is read live at resolution time rather than captured on the batch in oberi(). Because owning it moves the ideal band from 9–12 to 8–14, buying it mid-dry instantly re-classifies every batch currently in the dryer.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured: two identical batches, both sitting at drying day 8. Finish batch A with no upgrade — day 8 < d1 (9), so tochnost = 0.55 'предвреме', quality 61.4 = 'Среден' (×1.1). Buy Професионална сушара (300 000), then finish batch B in the same instant — day 8 is now within 8–14, tochnost = 1.00, quality 73.5 = 'Одличен' (×1.6). A 45 % price swing on an identical batch from a purchase made after drying finished. The same trick rescues over-dried batches: a batch at day 13 or 14 scores 0.80 without the upgrade and 1.00 with it.
findings.fix: Capture `imaSushara: sostojba.nadgradbi.sushara` on the batch object pushed in oberi(), and pass `serija.imaSushara` to tochnostOdSushenje(); default it to `false` for batches loaded from older saves in the vchitaj() sushara filter. panelSushara() should use the per-batch flag for its d1/d2 display too, so the window shown matches the window that will be scored.

findings.title: A single Полеј or Ѓубри click on a freshly planted bed is guaranteed to push the plant into the damage band, and repeat Ѓубри charges 250 ден for literally nothing
findings.location: polej(): `r.voda = stegni(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, 0, 100)`; nahrani(): `r.hraniva = stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, 100)` after `naplati(KONFIG.CENA_HRANA)`
findings.problem: Plants start at voda 70 / hraniva 70 (zasadiSemka). VODA_DOZA is 45 and HRANA_DOZA is 40, but both actions clamp to 100 while the safe ceilings are VODA_MAX 95 and HRANA_MAX 95. 70 + 45 and 70 + 40 both clamp to 100, which is above the ceiling, so the very first care action a player performs on a new bed always starts root rot / nutrient burn. Worse, nahrani() calls naplati() BEFORE checking whether the dose can do anything, so feeding an already-full plant costs 250 ден and delivers zero nutrients while extending the burn. Neither on-bed button is disabled or annotated with the safe range, so nothing signals this.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured on a fresh Скопско Зелено bed, pari 8000, hraniva 70: click Ѓубри → hraniva 100, pari 7750 (already above HRANA_MAX 95, burn active). Click Ѓубри again → hraniva 100, pari 7500 — 250 ден spent for +0 nutrients. Click again → 7250, still +0. 14 ticks later zdravje has dropped from 100 to 92.60 from a care action the player paid for. The same happens on the first Полеј: voda 70 → 100, which is above VODA_MAX 95, so −0.8/tick root rot until it drains back under 95.
findings.fix: Clamp the doses to the safe band rather than to 100: `stegni(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, 0, KONFIG.VODA_MAX)` and `stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, KONFIG.HRANA_MAX)` (keep the >MAX damage rules for saves/states that are already above it). In nahrani(), bail out before naplati() when `r.hraniva >= KONFIG.HRANA_MAX` so the player is never charged for a no-op, and disable/relabel the Ѓубри button in iscrtajLeja() while the plant is already full.

findings.title: Plants never die and a completely un-cared-for crop still turns a profit, so the intended failure state does not exist
findings.location: tikni() health block (`r.zdravje = stegni(r.zdravje + delta, 0, 100)`) and oberi()/presmetajPrinos — there is no zdravje === 0 death path anywhere
findings.problem: zdravje is clamped at 0 but nothing consumes that; the plant keeps ageing through every phase, reaches ZRELO, and is harvestable. presmetajPrinos returns `sorta.prinos * Math.pow(zdrav, 1.2) * lampa.prinosMult` with no floor, and presmetajKvalitet has a taban of `30 * genetika` that survives regardless of health, so even a corpse grades above zero. Spec §9 asserts "With no care at all the same plant loses 95 ден, so neglect is a real failure state" — that is not what the code does.
findings.failure_scenario: Measured: plant the free starter Скопско Зелено seed and never click anything. voda hits 0, hraniva hits 0, zdravje reaches 0 by roughly game day 19 and stays there for the remaining ~55 days, yet the plant advances through VEGETACIJA → CVETANJE → ZRELO normally. Harvest and dry it: 9.36 g at quality 24.4 ('Слаб', ×0.6), which sells for roughly 505 ден at pazar 1.0 against a 150 ден seed — a net gain, not a loss. Combined with the over-ripe finding above, a zero-effort player is never punished; they simply earn less.
findings.fix: Add a death path in tikni(): track consecutive ticks at zdravje === 0 on the plant and, past a threshold (e.g. 3 game days), clear `sostojba.lei[i].rastenie`, fire a Macedonian toast, and set panelValjaSe. Alternatively (or additionally) floor the payout — have presmetajPrinos return 0 below some prosekZdravje threshold — so the seed cost is genuinely lost.
